description: This file defines the ObsService interface for managing observations within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes method signatures for retrieving, saving, voiding, purging, and searching observations, as well as handling complex observation data and associated handlers.

methods.name: setObsDAO
methods.description: Assigns a specific Data Access Object (DAO) implementation for database operations related to observations.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an observation by its internal integer ID, throwing an APIException if not found or on error.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an observation by its UUID. Returns null if no matching observation exists.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Gets the revision observation for an initial observation, used for tracking edits.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves or updates an observation in the database, handling new and existing records accordingly.

methods.name: voidObs
methods.description: Voids a given observation, marking it as inactive with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidObs
methods.description: Reactivates a voided observation.

methods.name: purgeObs
methods.description: Deletes an observation from the database permanently.

methods.name: purgeObs (with cascade)
methods.description: Deletes an observation with optional cascading to related linked data.

methods.name: getObservationsByPerson
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided observations associated with a specific person, sorted by date.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Fetches observations based on various optional filtering criteria including persons, encounters, concepts, locations, sorting, date range, and visibility (voided or not).

methods.name: getObservations (with accession number)
methods.description: Extended version of getObservations that also filters by accession number.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of observations matching various optional filters, including date and location ranges and whether to include voided data.

methods.name: getObservationCount (with accession number)
methods.description: Extended version of getObservationCount that filters by accession number.

methods.name: getObservations (search string)
methods.description: Searches for observations matching a given string, such as patient identifiers or observation IDs.

methods.name: getObservationsByPersonAndConcept
methods.description: Fetches observations for a specific person and concept, excluding voided observations.

methods.name: getComplexObs
methods.description: Retrieves a complex observation with its data, deprecated in favor of getObs(Integer).

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler responsible for processing complex observations based on a key or an observation.

methods.name: setHandlers
methods.description: Registers a map of complex observation handlers, replacing existing handlers if keys overlap.

methods.name: getHandlers
methods.description: Provides the current map of registered complex observation handlers.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a single complex observation handler with a specific key.

methods.name: registerHandler (class)
methods.description: Loads and registers a handler class under a specified key.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Unregisters a handler associated with a given key.

methods.name: getObservationCount (by concept names)
methods.description: Counts observations associated with specific concept names, optionally including voided data.

methods.name: getObservations with visits
methods.description: Retrieves observations filtered by visits in addition to standard criteria, added in version 2.7.0.

methods.name: getObservationCount (with visits)
methods.description: Counts observations filtered by visits in addition to other criteria, version 2.7.0.
